cardiology_services_details: We offer a comprehensive range of services, including electrocardiography (ECG), echocardiography and diagnostic and interventional cardiac catheterization. Our team builds personalized care plans for conditions such as coronary artery disease, heart rhythm disorders and heart failure.
pediatrics_services_details: We offer a full spectrum of pediatric services, including routine check-ups, vaccinations, developmental screenings, and treatment for common childhood illnesses. Our team collaborates to create tailored care plans, ensuring the best possible health outcomes for your child.
urology_description: Our Urology Department provides expert care for conditions affecting the urinary tract and reproductive system. We offer advanced diagnostics and treatments with a focus on patient comfort and well-being.
urology_services_details: We provide comprehensive urological care, including treatment for kidney stones, urinary infections, prostate issues, and infertility. Our specialists use cutting-edge technology to ensure optimal outcomes.
orthopedics_services_details: We provide a wide range of orthopedic services, including joint replacement, fracture care, sports injury management, and minimally invasive procedures. Our team is dedicated to improving patient outcomes through personalized treatment plans.
general_medicine_description: Our General Medicine Department is committed to providing holistic care for patients of all ages, focusing on prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of a wide range of health conditions to promote overall wellness.
general_medicine_services_details: We offer comprehensive general medical services, including routine physical exams, chronic disease management, preventive care, and acute illness treatment. Our team works to ensure your long-term health and well-being.
dental_surgery_services_details: We provide comprehensive dental surgery services, including jaw surgery, dental implants, orthodontics, pediatric dental care, and nerve and gum surgery, ensuring optimal oral health outcomes.
gastroenterology_description: Our Gastroenterology Department specializes in diagnosing and treating disorders of the digestive system. We provide expert care with a focus on improving patient health and quality of life.
gastroenterology_services_details: We offer a wide range of services, including endoscopy, treatment for liver diseases, management of gastrointestinal disorders, and nutritional counseling, all tailored to meet individual patient needs.
medical_services: What medical services do you offer?
medical_services_answer: We offer a wide range of services: general medicine and emergency, cardiology, dentistry and oral surgery, pediatrics and pediatric endocrinology, obstetrics and gynecology, pulmonology, internal medicine and gastroenterology, ENT, urology, nephrology, orthopedics, surgical services and home healthcare, as well as blood and genetics laboratories, radiology, corporate medical exams and Wafid medical exams.
emergency_services_answer: Yes, our Emergency Department operates 24/7 with a rapid-response team to handle urgent medical cases.
diagnostic_services: What diagnostic services do you provide?
diagnostic_services_answer: Our Radiology Department provides X-ray, dental panoramic imaging and ultrasound, alongside our blood and genetics laboratories equipped with the latest devices such as Roche and Sysmex.
appointment_booking: How can I book an appointment?
appointment_booking_answer: You can book through the booking form on our website, by phone or via WhatsApp. We recommend booking in advance for consultations and procedures.
specialized_care: Do you offer specialized care for women and children
specialized_care_answer: Yes. We provide comprehensive women's health services, including pregnancy follow-up, reproductive health and laparoscopic surgery, and our Pediatrics Department offers specialized care including growth monitoring, vaccinations and treatment of endocrine disorders and diabetes in children.

health_nutrition_description: Our Health and Nutrition Department provides expert guidance on achieving optimal wellness through personalized nutrition plans and lifestyle adjustments, focusing on preventative care and vitality.

internal_medicine_desc: Comprehensive care for adult health and chronic conditions.
internal_medicine_services_details: We provide a wide range of services including management of chronic diseases, preventive health screenings, diagnostic evaluations, and personalized treatment plans.
gynecology_desc: Specialized care for women's health, pregnancy and childbirth, and gynecological conditions.
gynecology_services_details: We offer a wide range of services, including pregnancy and delivery follow-up, pelvic exams and Pap smears, infertility treatment, laparoscopic surgery, surgical and non-surgical intimate cosmetic procedures, and treatment of conditions such as endometriosis, ovarian cysts and menopause.
about_us_description: Elite Medical Care is an integrated medical facility aimed at providing all patient needs for comprehensive medical care, including specialty clinics, emergency clinics, dental clinics, diagnostic imaging and ultrasound, and medical laboratories with blood lab and genetic testing sections equipped with the latest global devices ensuring high accuracy and speed in issuing results, in addition to pre-employment and periodic check-ups for employees.
vision_description: To be the leading and trusted medical facility in Jordan, by providing comprehensive and innovative healthcare, using the latest global technologies, while adhering to the highest standards of accuracy and quality to serve our patients and the community.
blood_labs__details: Elite Medical Center offers a comprehensive range of laboratory tests designed to meet the diverse health needs of all age groups with the highest standards of accuracy and care. Our services include hair analysis, thyroid function tests, pediatric diagnostics, obesity-related assessments, pregnancy and maternity panels, as well as fertility tests for both women and men. We also provide cancer marker screenings for males and females. In addition, we offer premium Gold and Diamond packages that combine essential and advanced tests. Through these services, we aim to empower our patients with proactive, reliable healthcare tailored to their well-being.

nephrology_description: Our Nephrology Clinic offers specialized care for a wide range of kidney diseases, acute and chronic kidney failure, hypertension, and fluid/electrolyte disorders. Our expert team is dedicated to providing personalized treatment plans and the highest standard of medical care to protect and improve your kidney health.
nephrology_services_details: We offer comprehensive nephrology services including diagnosis and treatment of diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis, kidney stone prevention, clinical management of chronic kidney disease, hypertension control, and preparation/follow-up for dialysis and kidney transplantation.
ent_services_details: We provide diagnostic and therapeutic services for hearing loss, ear infections, tinnitus, balance disorders, chronic sinusitis, nasal obstruction, tonsillitis, voice and swallowing disorders, snoring, and sleep apnea, alongside specialized pediatric ENT care.
emergency_desc: 24/7 immediate medical care for acute illnesses and traumatic injuries.
emergency_services_details: Our Emergency Department provides complete emergency care, including rapid triage, cardiopulmonary resuscitation, management of acute conditions, respiratory therapy, fracture and injury care, wound care and suturing, as well as pediatric emergency care, with 24/7 access to our laboratory and diagnostic imaging.

blood_labs_about_1: The Blood and Genetics Laboratories at Elite Medical Care provide medical analyses, laboratory tests and genetic testing using the latest diagnostic technologies and equipment, in line with accredited standards of quality and accuracy.
blood_labs_about_2: We strive to deliver reliable results that support the early detection of disease, the assessment of overall health and the diagnosis of hereditary and genetic disorders, strengthening the quality of healthcare and prevention.
emergency_about_1: The Emergency Department is one of the key departments at Elite Medical Care. It provides urgent medical care for emergencies, injuries and health conditions that require prompt medical assessment and intervention.
emergency_about_2: We are committed to fast and effective medical care delivered by qualified staff, with careful case assessment, triage and treatment suited to the nature of each case, ensuring patient safety and high-quality service.
radiology_about_1: The Radiology Department at Elite Medical Care provides medical imaging and diagnostic radiology services, using modern technologies and equipment to help detect diseases and injuries and assess health conditions accurately.
radiology_about_2: We strive to provide reliable diagnostic imaging through specialized staff, ensuring image quality, accurate results and patient safety, so physicians can make the right medical decisions and treatment plans.
dental_about_1: The Dental Department at Elite Medical Care provides comprehensive oral and dental medicine and surgery, offering preventive, restorative and cosmetic care with modern technologies and equipment, delivered by specialized dental staff.
dental_about_2: We aim to protect oral and dental health and to offer patients a comfortable and safe treatment experience, focusing on accurate diagnosis and the right treatment plan for every case to achieve the best results and a healthy, beautiful smile.
cardiology_about_1: The Cardiology Department at Elite Medical Care provides specialized services for the diagnosis, follow-up and treatment of heart and vascular diseases, offering medical and preventive care based on the latest diagnostic and therapeutic methods.
cardiology_about_2: We work to promote heart health and prevent heart disease through early detection, accurate medical assessment, follow-up of cardiac conditions and a suitable treatment plan for every patient, under the supervision of specialized physicians.
pediatrics_about_1: The Department of Pediatrics, Pediatric Endocrinology and Diabetes at Elite Medical Care provides comprehensive, specialized care for children's health, growth and development, with particular attention to diagnosing and treating endocrine and hormonal disorders and diabetes in children.
pediatrics_about_2: We provide integrated care tailored to each child's needs through accurate medical assessment, continuous follow-up and health education, under the supervision of specialized physicians, to support healthy growth.
gynecology_about_1: The Obstetrics and Gynecology Department at Elite Medical Care provides specialized women's healthcare, including preventive, diagnostic and therapeutic care and the follow-up of reproductive health and gynecological conditions, according to the latest medical practice.
gynecology_about_2: We provide comprehensive care for women at every stage of life through accurate diagnosis, continuous follow-up and specialized consultations, in a safe medical environment that respects each patient's privacy and needs.
respiratory_about_1: The Respiratory Clinic at Elite Medical Care provides specialized services for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of respiratory and lung diseases, offering medical consultations, diagnostic tests and suitable treatment plans for a wide range of respiratory conditions.
respiratory_about_2: We aim to improve respiratory health and quality of life through early detection of respiratory diseases, continuous follow-up and care based on the latest medical practice, under the supervision of specialized physicians.
internal_medicine_about_1: The Internal Medicine Department at Elite Medical Care provides integrated services for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of adult diseases, with a focus on prevention, early detection and comprehensive health assessment.
internal_medicine_about_2: We rely on accurate medical assessment, appropriate diagnostic tests and individual treatment plans for every patient, under the supervision of specialized physicians, to promote general health and improve quality of life.
ent_about_1: The ENT Clinic at Elite Medical Care provides specialized services for the diagnosis and treatment of ear, nose and throat diseases and disorders, including problems with hearing, balance, breathing, voice and swallowing.
ent_about_2: We offer integrated care based on accurate diagnosis, specialized tests and the right treatment plan for every case, under the supervision of qualified physicians, to improve our patients' health and quality of life.
orthopedics_about_1: The Orthopedics Department at Elite Medical Care provides specialized services for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of bone diseases and injuries.
orthopedics_about_2: We provide integrated care that aims to relieve pain, restore movement and normal function and improve quality of life, through accurate diagnosis and the right treatment plan for each case, under the supervision of specialized physicians.
general_surgery_about_1: The Surgical Services Department at Elite Medical Care provides specialized surgical assessment, diagnosis and care, offering surgical consultations and follow-up for cases that require surgical intervention, according to the latest medical practice and standards.
general_surgery_about_2: We provide complete surgical care, from medical assessment and accurate diagnosis, through the appropriate surgical intervention, to post-operative follow-up and care, with a focus on patient safety and the best treatment outcomes.
home_care_about_1: Elite Medical Care's Home Healthcare service provides a range of medical and nursing services in the patient's home, offering complete and comfortable care without the need to travel to a medical center, while respecting each patient's individual needs.
home_care_about_2: We provide home care that combines quality, attention and privacy through qualified medical and nursing staff, serving patients, the elderly, people with chronic diseases and anyone who needs continuous follow-up and care.
